messages:
Anya: Quick question — onboarding issue: sample app sets REDWOOD_API_KEY but our CLI expects REDWOOD_KEY and SDKs both look in different places. Users are getting 401s.
kevin: Oof. Which SDKs are out of parity?
Anya: Node & Python differ. Node checks REDWOOD_API_KEY -> project scope, Python prefers REDWOOD_KEY -> org by default.
sam: That explains support tickets. We surfaced a repro where deets show token scope mismatch.
lina: Is this the same as the project/org scoping debate? we decided org default earlier but never landed env var standardization.
kevin: Right. We also don't have an explicit precedence table in the CLI. CLI: --key, env REDWOOD_KEY, env REDWOOD_API_KEY, and GCP metadata fallback — order is messy.
Anya: Proposed minimal fix: (1) SDKs should support both env vars with a clear precedence: CLI arg > REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_KEY > metadata. (2) Add REDWOOD_API_SCOPE to opt into project-scoped tokens for local dev.
sam: I like explicit REDWOOD_API_SCOPE for clarity. Suggest values: org|project|auto. auto = infer from token format.
lina: Parity action items? patch python SDK to accept REDWOOD_API_KEY and respect precedence, update docs and sample app to use REDWOOD_API_SCOPE=project for project-scoped onboarding.
kevin: Also need rotation UX: rotation-bot should post when key is rotated with token fingerprint so old tokens are invalidated and SDKs can detect 401 + x-redwood-error:stale-token to trigger refresh.
rotation-bot: heads-up: automated rotation completed for infra-team — 2 old keys revoked, 1 new key issued (fingerprint ab:12). :rotating_light:
Anya: Nice. For detection, can we standardize a retry code path: on 401 + stale-token header -> fail fast and surface link to CLI `redwood keys rotate --replace`?
sam: Will add quick handler in node SDK today, python PR tomorrow. Keep it simple: don't auto-rotate unless CLI-issued ephemeral keys.
lina: I'll update sample app and docs with example:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=rgk_abc123
export REDWOOD_API_SCOPE=project
node sample-app.js
```
kevin: Also add a short troubleshooting section: "Why am I getting 401 after onboarding?" with steps.
Anya: Cool. Who wants to own the cross-repo PR to sync precedence table?
kevin: I'll do it, pinging infra for metadata fallback checks.
sam: I'll open the SDK issues and link to kevin's PR.
lina: I'll push doc updates and a small CHANGELOG entry.
Anya: Thanks all — hopefully fewer support handoffs tomorrow :thumbsup:
